authority.purpose: prospective acquisition of information channels that are absent from the historical workspace

decision.late_payload_rule: store the payload with late=true but do not expose it to that target date's feature view
decision.clock: NTP-synchronized collector clock with offset and synchronization status persisted on every run

invariants: no_activity is valid only when coverage_status is complete
field_status keys exactly equal value keys
observed values are non-null; zero values are numeric zero; missing/not_applicable values are null
raw objects are content-addressed and immutable

tdnet_numeric_and_body.required_access: J-Quants TDnet add-on or J-Quants Pro for official structured fields; immutable official PDF bytes when body semantics are required. Confirm the legal entity, historical depth and internal-use/research terms before activation.
tdnet_numeric_and_body.cadence: poll continuously from 06:00 through 08:58:59 and persist publisher event time, first local receipt time and parse completion time
validation: join old and new values only when period, scope, currency and unit agree
store source cell coordinates and extraction confidence
body-level negation overrides title-level supportive flags
corrections create a new immutable record and supersession edge; they never overwrite the original

pit_security_master_and_liquidity.required_access: J-Quants/DataCube or another licensed source for daily volume, turnover, VWAP and effective-dated listed-issue master; execution records from the actual broker
pit_security_master_and_liquidity.cadence: seal D-1 market and master data after D-1 close and before D 08:58:59
validation: no-trade and missing-file states are distinct
corporate-action adjustments use only actions announced by the decision cutoff
spread proxies keep a _proxy suffix and never populate observed-spread fields

ose_futures.required_access: broker market-data API with OSE futures entitlement for prospective collection, or licensed OSE historical feed for backfill
instruments: Nikkei 225 front contract selected by a predeclared roll calendar
TOPIX front contract selected by the same predeclared roll principle
validation: contract selection is fixed before observing same-day volume
stale last trade is marked separately from missing quote
daily futures OHLC and CFD values are not accepted as 08:58 substitutes

tse_preopen_auction.required_access: broker market-data API for a prospectively fixed candidate set, or licensed JPX 10-level reconstruction data for historical work
tse_preopen_auction.candidate_rule: freeze candidate instrument ids before 08:57 using only cutoff-valid upstream features; persist the rejected and selected candidate set
validation: the 09:00 actual open is label-only and cannot repair a missing indicative price
all four scheduled snapshots report coverage independently
cancellations or orders received after 08:58:59 are excluded from the frozen view

pts.required_access: Japannext ITCH/GLIMPSE or an authorized vendor agreement for exact venue/session data

sessions.night: 17:00 through 06:00, collected only after the session-complete marker

validation: night and day sessions are never combined before raw persistence
venue-specific observations are not replaced by SOR aggregates
complete no-trade sessions use volume=0 and last_price=null
API failure uses missing values, not zero

daily_freeze_sequence: After D-1 close, seal D-1 liquidity, capital structure, trading unit, tick and known corporate actions.
At the PTS night-session end, persist the complete venue/session record.
From 06:00, persist every received TDnet payload and parse attempt.
At 08:57:00, freeze the auction candidate set and start scheduled futures/auction snapshots.
At 08:58:59, create a content-addressed feature-view manifest containing only cutoff-valid records.
After 09:00, persist actual open and execution records into a physically separate label ledger.
After the close, add the D open-to-close label without mutating the frozen feature manifest.

quality_gates_before_any_model_test.note: The pilot is data-quality-only. Its labels must remain sealed until the subsequent model protocol, hypotheses and forward horizon are preregistered.

required_audits: operational replay from immutable raw objects
sequestered_forward_test.promotion_rule: Must be frozen in a new protocol before the first forward label is opened; this collector specification does not itself authorize promotion.
